item.title: Searching for Arrays of Size 1 in MySQL
item.description: Dealing with arrays in MySQL can be challenging, especially when you need to search for arrays of a specific size, such as arrays of size 1. This article explores techniques to identify and extract data when searching for arrays of size 1 in MySQL. 1. Using JSON Functions (MySQL 5.7 and Later): If the arrays are stored as JSON in a column, you can leverage JSON functions available in MySQL 5.
